FLUQON.QPON / HELP

A few straight answers.

How the feed, saved list, sharing and app work.

Are these current deals?

The live feed shows published offers with a current dated check. A merchant check confirms the retailer’s published offer; a checkout check records an accepted code or price. Stale, paused, patched and expired offers are removed. preview.fluq_ shows clearly marked, unchecked interface examples.

Is this a cashback service?

No. fluqon.qpon currently helps you browse coupon and offer information. There is no cashback balance, purchase tracking or payout account.

How does the saved list work?

Choose save.fluq_ on an offer. Only its ID is stored in this browser on this device; it is not sent to a server. Use saved.fluq_ above the feed to see your shortlist. Clearing browser data removes it. If storage is blocked, saving works for that visit only.

Does a saved code stay available offline?

No. Saving an offer does not reserve the price or store the coupon page offline. An internet connection is required to check the current page.

Can I get email alerts?

Sign-ups are not open yet. Confirmation and unsubscribe email delivery must be connected and tested before we collect subscriber addresses.

What does Report Patched do?

It opens a short form. Your report is stored in a private review queue and returns a reference. The operator checks the offer before resolving the report. One report does not automatically mark a deal as patched.

How do the share links work?

share.fluq_ opens your device’s share sheet where supported, with a copy-link fallback. Homepage links use /s/fluq; individual offers have their own shortlink and detail page.

Can I install it as an app?

Yes. Choose install.fluq_ in the footer, or use Chrome’s install option. It opens in its own window with the separate f icon.

Something needs fixing?

report.fluq_ ↗ opens the report form. No email address or login needed. Please leave out payment and account details.
